data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to use Kakao Map JavaScript API on Android, iOS, and Web via WebView and iframe.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to embed Kakao Maps into Flutter applications across Android, iOS, and Web. It uses webview_flutter for mobile platforms and iframe for the web, providing controllers, markers, clusterers, and search functionalities.
use_when: You need to integrate Kakao Maps into a Flutter cross-platform app for Android, iOS, and Web.
You want to use Kakao Maps features such as markers, custom overlays, and location search.
avoid_when: You require native SDK implementations rather than a WebView/iframe-based wrapper.
You need features not supported by the Kakao JavaScript API like map rotation, tilt, or 3D buildings.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
Covers official Kakao Maps JS samples and features like clustering and search.
weaknesses: Web requires manual domain registration in the Kakao Developer console.
Does not support native mapping SDKs, relying instead on WebView and iframe.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a Kakao JavaScript key, adding internet permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, NSAppTransportSecurity configurations in Info.plist, and registering domain origins for Web.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer native Google Maps over Kakao Maps.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want an open-source, tile-based mapping solution using Leaflet without depending on commercial map APIs.
